# xNet

xNet is an early-beta desktop community network built with Rust and Tauri.
The consumer site is https://xnet.fyi and essays are at https://xnet.fyi/blog.
Current contributor instructions: https://github.com/crs48/xNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
The old SDK is retired: https://github.com/crs48/xNet/tree/legacy-sdk-2026-11-18
Historical essays may describe the old CRDT workspace, not the current app.
